intro.heading: Hello, Client.
intro.lead: You told me what's working, what isn't, and where you want to be a year from now. This proposal lays out how we get there together: what I'll make, how we'll work, when it lands and what it costs.
body: Everything here is a starting point. If something feels off, tell me and we'll shape it until it fits.

current: Describe the current state in two or three sentences. What's the brand saying today, where does the site fall short, and what is that costing the business?

goals.title: Look the part
goals.body: A brand that matches the quality of the work, so first impressions stop underselling you.

goals.title: Convert visitors
goals.body: A site built around one clear next step, with pages that answer the real questions buyers ask.

goals.title: Own it
goals.body: A build and guide your team can update without calling a developer.

scope.title: Brand identity
scope.body: Logo suite, color, type and a guide your team can actually use.

scope.title: Website design
scope.body: Responsive layouts for every key page, designed in Figma and reviewed live.

scope.title: Development
scope.body: A fast, accessible site with a CMS your team can update on its own.

scope.title: Content & SEO
scope.body: Page structure, metadata, redirects and copy edits that help people find you.

scope.title: Motion
scope.body: Page transitions, scroll reveals and hover moments that feel smooth, not busy.

scope.title: Launch & support
scope.body: Domain, QA across devices, analytics and 30 days of fixes after launch.

processAccent: One clear sign-off at the end of each.

process.title: Discover
process.body: Kickoff, stakeholder interviews, audit and a creative brief we both sign off on.

process.title: Design
process.body: Brand directions, then the chosen one applied to key pages. Two rounds of revisions.

process.title: Build
process.body: Development, CMS setup, motion and content load. Review on a staging link.

process.title: Launch
process.body: Cross-device QA, SEO and redirects, go live, team walkthrough and handoff.

items.detail: Logo suite, palette, type, brand guide
Up to 8 page templates, mobile + desktop

terms.title: Revisions
terms.body: Two rounds per phase are included. Extra rounds are billed at the hourly rate.

terms.title: Ownership
terms.body: You own the final files and code once the last invoice is paid.

terms.title: Your part
terms.body: Timely feedback, content and access. Delays on either side move the timeline.

terms.title: Changes
terms.body: New requests outside this scope get a quick written estimate before any work starts.

terms.title: Hourly rate
terms.body: $000 / hour for anything outside the agreed scope.

terms.title: Cancellation
terms.body: Either side can end with written notice. Work to date is billed and delivered.

nextSteps.title: Approve this proposal
nextSteps.body: Tap Review & sign to sign the agreement in DocuSign. That locks your spot in the calendar.

nextSteps.title: Pay the deposit
nextSteps.body: The first invoice is 50%. Your start date is confirmed once it clears.

nextSteps.title: Kickoff
nextSteps.body: A 60-minute call to meet the team and start discovery.
